description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a team modernizing reporting and supporting analytical applications in a complex business environment. You will build and maintain reporting and analytics solutions using a broad full stack and business intelligence toolkit.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop, enhance, and maintain reporting and analytics applications.

 - Build Java REST APIs and full stack solutions with modern web technologies.

 - Develop data visualizations and business intelligence solutions.

 - Support cloud-based data solutions and follow DevOps and CI/CD practices.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of full stack software development experience.

 - Proficiency in Python and Java, including Java REST APIs.

 - Experience with Angular, Tableau, Power BI, AWS, Oracle databases, and PL/SQL.

 - Knowledge of DevOps, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices.

 - Financial services domain knowledge is preferred.

 - Experience with data warehouse implementations and AI-powered solutions is preferred.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $68,000 to $90,000 annually. Additional incentive compensation may be available, depending on the position and applicable policies. Benefits may include paid time off, health coverage, retirement savings plans, insurance, and employee assistance programs, subject to local policy and eligibility.


LOCATION

On-site in Irving, Texas, United States.
